faqs: Do you cater small birthday parties at home?
Yes. Share your guest count and venue, and we will suggest a menu and service style that suits a smaller gathering.
Can you make the food less spicy for children?
Yes. We keep a mild version of the main dishes for children and regular spice for adults.
Can you arrange the birthday cake as well?
Ask us when you book and we will tell you what we can arrange along with your menu.
